theorems.name: Submission.dor_lmb_fcl_good_level
theorems.statement: ∀ (ν : ℕ → Measure ℝ) (F : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ≥0∞) (Good : ℕ → ℝ → Prop) (a b : ℝ) (Λ : ℝ≥0∞), a < b → Λ ≠ ∞ → (∀ j, ν j (Icc a b) ≤ Λ) → (∀ j, AEMeasurable (F j)) → (∀ j, ∫⁻ t, F j t ≤ Λ) → (∀ j, ∀ᵐ t, Good j t) → ∃ s ∈ Ioo a b, ∃ (φ : ℕ → ℕ) (C : ℝ≥0∞), StrictMono φ ∧ C ≠ ∞ ∧ (∀ j, Good j s) ∧ (∀ j, F (φ j) s ≤ C) ∧ ∀ ε : ℝ≥0∞, 0 < ε → ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ᶠ j in atTop, ν (φ j) (Icc (s - δ) s) ≤ ε
